author: Scopoli, 1769
status: 겨울철새, 해마다 수십 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
habitat: 촌락 부근, 성벽, 벼랑, 강가의 무너진 흙더미, 고목 부근
summary: 올빼미 가운데 가장 작은 종으로, 깊은 숲에는 살지 않고 마을 가까이나 성벽, 벼랑, 강가의 무너져 내린 흙더미, 오래된 나무 둘레에 산다. 한배에 알을 3~7개 낳아 26~28일 동안 품는다. 울음소리는 고양이나 갓난아기가 우는 소리를 닮았고, 작은 포유류, 새, 파충류, 양서류, 곤충 따위를 잡아먹는다. 날개 길이는 14.8~15.8cm이며, 한국 중부 이북과 중국, 몽골에 분포한다.

art.subject: Little Owl (Athene noctua), adult male in winter, as seen around Korean villages, banks and old trees: crown greyish-brown densely spotted with small buff-white dots; broad whitish eyebrows giving a frowning look; upperparts greyish buff-brown with larger whitish spots; white chin and a white band across the throat; underparts buffy-white with broad dark buff-brown streaks on the breast, flanks and belly. Bill pale yellow; eyes bright lemon-yellow; legs and toes feathered whitish, claws dark brown.
art.pose: perched upright on a crumbling earth bank
art.scene: Korean village outskirts by a river in winter, with a collapsed earth bank, a low cliff and an old bare tree among dry grasses; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view perched: greyish buff-brown upperparts with whitish spots, crown with fine buff dots, flat head, pale yellow bill, dark brown claws, short tail
adult winter, front view perched: white chin, broad whitish eyebrows over bright yellow eyes, buffy-white underparts with broad dark streaks
art.build: Small, stocky owl, roughly the length of a starling but much plumper, with a broad, flat-topped head without ear tufts and no visible neck. Bill short and hooked. Legs fairly long for an owl, feathered. Tail short and barred. Stands upright on banks, walls, rocks or posts and bobs when alarmed. Flight low and bounding on rounded wings.
avoid: Do not give it ear tufts; that would be a scops owl.
Do not paint dark eyes; the eyes are bright yellow.
Do not make it large or long-tailed; it is a small, compact owl with a short tail.
Do not paint a dark bill; it is pale yellow.
